name: Nature (single column)
notes: Single-column Nature artwork. Canvas height is a working default (figures vary); pass meta.canvas.h_mm to override. Type is clamped to the contract floors, so main_title 9 pt in a journal guideline would still print at 11 pt.
source: Nature author guidelines, 'Figures' (https://www.nature.com/nature/for-authors/final-submission): single column 89 mm, double column 183 mm, minimum 5 pt type, line weights >= 0.25 pt. Column widths are from the guideline; the exact pt/margins/height values used here are working values (see param_source).

canvas_mm.height.detail: working default; every figure overrides it

dpi.detail: Nature asks for >=300 dpi raster artwork

font_sizes_pt.detail: rounded working sizes inside Nature's 5-7 pt body range; panel_title/main_title raised to the contract floors

line_widths_pt.detail: working values, all above Nature's 0.25 pt minimum

margins_mm.detail: working margins; left margin sized for a 3-digit tick label
